titles.romaji: Dragon Ball Z: Kyokugen Battle!! Sandai Super Saiyajin Special
titles.native: ドラゴンボールＺ　極限バトル！！三大超サイヤ人　スペシャル

description: A rare TV special that is part of the Dragon Ball Z series. This special was aired on Tokai TV a month after the release of Dragon Ball Z: Super Android 13!, between episodes 150 and 151.
